items.headline: [P] PhAIL (phail.ai) – an open benchmark for robot AI on real hardware. Best model: 5% of human throughput, needs help every 4 minutes.
items.summary: I spent the last year trying to answer a simple question: how good are VLA models on real commercial tasks? Not demos, not simulation, not success rates on 10 tries. Actual production metrics on real hardware. I couldn't find honest numbers anywhere, so I built a benchmark. Setup: DROID platform, bin-to-bin order picking – one of the most common warehouse and industrial operations. items.headline: I scanned 10 popular vibe-coded repos with a deterministic linter. 4,513 findings across 2,062 files. Here's what AI agents keep getting wrong.
items.summary: I build a lot with Claude Code. Across 8 different projects. At some point I noticed a pattern: every codebase had the same structural issues showing up again and again. God functions that were 200+ lines. Empty catch blocks everywhere. console.log left in production paths. any types scattered across TypeScript files.
